method: Every Game-world frame, shared localhost UTC; measured wall intervals, not clamped simulation DeltaSeconds. Mesh is game-thread presentation, not photon/scanout latency. No packet injection or smoothing tuning.

cases.packetCadenceCaveat: All changed-position intervals retain the deliberate two-second stop. Moving intervals require both endpoints in the same actual W-held window; stationary actor positions do not imply packet loss.
cases.displayCaveat: Onset at mesh and packet can share a frame; this does not imply zero ongoing smoothing. Offset is relative to extrapolated proxy capsule, not server-to-photon latency.
